Metadata.Time Period: 2015 to present (All police districts September 2017 - present)

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: A unique identifier for each person record. IDs starting with P indicate passengers. IDs starting with O indicate a person who was not a passenger in the vehicle (e.g., driver, pedestrian, cyclist, etc.).

columns.name: PERSON_TYPE
columns.description: Type of roadway user involved in crash

columns.name: CRASH_RECORD_ID
columns.description: This number can be used to link to the same crash in the Crashes and Vehicles datasets. This number also serves as a unique ID in the Crashes dataset.

columns.name: VEHICLE_ID
columns.description: The corresponding CRASH_UNIT_ID from the Vehicles dataset.

columns.name: CRASH_DATE
columns.description: Date and time of crash as entered by the reporting officer

columns.name: SEAT_NO
columns.description:
Code for seating position of motor vehicle occupant:

1= driver, 2= center front, 3 = front passenger, 4 = second row left, 5 = second row center, 6 = second row right, 7 = enclosed passengers, 8 = exposed passengers, 9= unknown position, 10 = third row left, 11 = third row center, 12 = third row right

columns.name: CITY
columns.description: City of residence of person involved in crash

columns.name: STATE
columns.description: State of residence of person involved in crash

columns.name: ZIPCODE
columns.description: ZIP Code of residence of person involved in crash

columns.name: SEX
columns.description: Gender of person involved in crash, as determined by reporting officer

columns.name: AGE
columns.description: Age of person involved in crash

columns.name: DRIVERS_LICENSE_STATE
columns.description: State issuing driver's license of person involved in crash

columns.name: DRIVERS_LICENSE_CLASS
columns.description: Class of driver's license of person involved in crash

columns.name: SAFETY_EQUIPMENT
columns.description: Safety equipment used by vehicle occupant in crash, if any

columns.name: AIRBAG_DEPLOYED
columns.description: Whether vehicle occupant airbag deployed as result of crash

columns.name: EJECTION
columns.description: Whether vehicle occupant was ejected or extricated from the vehicle as a result of crash

columns.name: INJURY_CLASSIFICATION
columns.description: Severity of injury person sustained in the crash

columns.name: HOSPITAL
columns.description: Hospital to which person injured in the crash was taken

columns.name: EMS_AGENCY
columns.description: EMS agency who transported person injured in crash to the hospital

columns.name: EMS_RUN_NO
columns.description: EMS agency run number

columns.name: DRIVER_ACTION
columns.description: Driver action that contributed to the crash, as determined by reporting officer

columns.name: DRIVER_VISION
columns.description: What, if any, objects obscured the driver’s vision at time of crash

columns.name: PHYSICAL_CONDITION
columns.description: Driver’s apparent physical condition at time of crash, as observed by the reporting officer

columns.name: PEDPEDAL_ACTION
columns.description: Action of pedestrian or cyclist at the time of crash

columns.name: PEDPEDAL_VISIBILITY
columns.description: Visibility of pedestrian of cyclist safety equipment in use at time of crash

columns.name: PEDPEDAL_LOCATION
columns.description: Location of pedestrian or cyclist at the time of crash

columns.name: BAC_RESULT
columns.description: Status of blood alcohol concentration testing for driver or other person involved in crash

columns.name: BAC_RESULT VALUE
columns.description: Driver’s blood alcohol concentration test result (fatal crashes may include pedestrian or cyclist results)

columns.name: CELL_PHONE_USE
columns.description: Whether person was/was not using cellphone at the time of the crash, as determined by the reporting officer
